# 1. Introduction

This report summarizes the overlap among candidate outliers detected using five different outlier-detection approaches:

1. BayPass C2
2. BayPass BF
3. BayeScan
4. PCAdapt with Benjamini-Hochberg correction
5. BayPass Local Score windows

The overlap is visualized using an UpSet plot generated with the `ggVennDiagram` package.

# 2. Packages

## 2.1. Install packages

```{r}

packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "janitor",
  "ggVennDiagram",
  "ggplot2",
  "ComplexUpset"
)

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

```

## 2.2. Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggVennDiagram)
```


# 5. Helper functions

## 5.1. Read tables function

```{r}

read_flexible_table <- function(file) {
  
  ext <- tools::file_ext(file)
  
  if (ext %in% c("csv")) {
    
    readr::read_csv(
      file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
    
  } else {
    
    readr::read_table(
      file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  }
}

```

## 5.2. Standardize CRH and POS

```{r}

standardise_chr_pos <- function(df) {
  
  df <- df %>% clean_names()
  
  chr_candidates <- c(
    "chr", "chrom", "chromosome", "chromosome_id",
    "scaffold", "contig", "seqid", "chrom_id"
  )
  
  pos_candidates <- c(
    "pos", "position", "bp", "snp_pos",
    "base_pair", "basepair", "position_bp"
  )
  
  chr_col <- chr_candidates[chr_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  pos_col <- pos_candidates[pos_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  
  if (is.na(chr_col)) {
    stop(
      "Could not find a chromosome/scaffold column.\n",
      "Available columns are:\n",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  if (is.na(pos_col)) {
    stop(
      "Could not find a SNP position column.\n",
      "Available columns are:\n",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  df %>%
    rename(
      CHR = all_of(chr_col),
      POS = all_of(pos_col)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      CHR = as.character(CHR),
      POS = as.numeric(POS),
      SNP_ID = paste(CHR, POS, sep = "_")
    )
}

```

## 5.3. Detect outlier column

```{r}

detect_outlier_column <- function(df) {
  
  df <- df %>% clean_names()
  
  candidates <- c(
    "outlier",
    "is_outlier",
    "outlier_flag",
    "flag_outlier",
    "significant",
    "is_significant",
    "candidate",
    "is_candidate",
    "outlier_c2",
    "outlier_bf",
    "c2_outlier",
    "bf_outlier"
  )
  
  outlier_col <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  
  if (is.na(outlier_col)) {
    stop(
      "Could not automatically find the outlier flag column.\n",
      "Available columns are:\n",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", "),
      "\n\nPlease rename your outlier column to one of:\n",
      paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  outlier_col
}

```

## 5.4. Detect logical expression

```{r}

to_logical_outlier <- function(x) {
  
  case_when(
    x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "True", "true", "yes", "YES", "Yes", 1, "1") ~ TRUE,
    x %in% c(FALSE, "FALSE", "False", "false", "no", "NO", "No", 0, "0") ~ FALSE,
    is.na(x) ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ as.logical(x)
  )
}

```

## 5.5. Read outlier flag table

```{r}

read_outlier_flag_table <- function(file, method_name) {
  
  df_raw <- read_flexible_table(file) %>%
    clean_names()
  
  outlier_col <- detect_outlier_column(df_raw)
  
  df_raw %>%
    standardise_chr_pos() %>%
    mutate(
      outlier_flag_tmp = to_logical_outlier(.data[[outlier_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(outlier_flag_tmp == TRUE) %>%
    distinct(CHR, POS, SNP_ID) %>%
    mutate(method = method_name)
}

```

## 5.6. Read merged table

```{r}

read_simple_outlier_table <- function(file, method_name) {
  
  read_flexible_table(file) %>%
    standardise_chr_pos() %>%
    distinct(CHR, POS, SNP_ID) %>%
    mutate(method = method_name)
}

```

## 5.7. Standardize local score windows

```{r}

standardise_windows <- function(df) {
  
  df <- df %>% clean_names()
  
  chr_candidates <- c(
    "chr", "chrom", "chromosome", "chromosome_id",
    "scaffold", "contig", "seqid", "chrom_id"
  )
  
  start_candidates <- c(
    "start", "begin", "beg", "window_start", "pos_start",
    "from", "left", "lower", "lower_bound"
  )
  
  end_candidates <- c(
    "end", "stop", "window_end", "pos_end",
    "to", "right", "upper", "upper_bound"
  )
  
  chr_col <- chr_candidates[chr_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  start_col <- start_candidates[start_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  end_col <- end_candidates[end_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  
  if (is.na(chr_col) | is.na(start_col) | is.na(end_col)) {
    stop(
      "Could not detect CHR/start/end columns in the significant windows file.\n",
      "Available columns are:\n",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  df %>%
    rename(
      CHR = all_of(chr_col),
      START = all_of(start_col),
      END = all_of(end_col)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      CHR = as.character(CHR),
      START = as.numeric(START),
      END = as.numeric(END)
    )
}
```

## 5.8. Extract local score outliers

```{r}

extract_local_score_outliers_one_contrast <- function(local_score_file,
                                                      windows_file,
                                                      contrast_id) {
  
  local_scores <- read_flexible_table(local_score_file) %>%
    standardise_chr_pos()
  
  windows <- read_flexible_table(windows_file) %>%
    standardise_windows()
  
  local_scores %>%
    inner_join(
      windows,
      by = "CHR",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(POS >= START, POS <= END) %>%
    distinct(CHR, POS, SNP_ID) %>%
    mutate(
      contrast_id = contrast_id,
      method = "LocalScores"
    )
}

```

# 8. Build the overlap master table

```{r}

# 8. Build the overlap master table

all_outliers_long <- bind_rows(
  C2_outliers,
  BF_outliers,
  BayeScan_outliers,
  PCAdapt_Bonferroni_outliers,
  LocalScores_outliers
) %>%
  mutate(
    method = case_when(
      method == "LocalScores" ~ "BayPass_LocalScores",
      method == "PCAdapt_Bonferroni" ~ "PCAdapt",
      TRUE ~ method
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(CHR, POS, SNP_ID, method)

methods <- c(
  "BayPass_C2",
  "BayPass_BF",
  "BayPass_LocalScores",
  #"BayeScan",
  "PCAdapt"
)

# Check if method names are correct before pivoting
print(sort(unique(all_outliers_long$method)))

missing_methods_in_long <- setdiff(methods, unique(all_outliers_long$method))

if (length(missing_methods_in_long) > 0) {
  warning(
    "These methods are not present in all_outliers_long: ",
    paste(missing_methods_in_long, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

upset_master_table <- all_outliers_long %>%
  mutate(value = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(CHR, POS, SNP_ID),
    names_from = method,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = FALSE
  )

# Add missing methods only if they are truly absent
for (m in methods) {
  if (!m %in% names(upset_master_table)) {
    upset_master_table[[m]] <- FALSE
  }
}

upset_master_table <- upset_master_table %>%
  mutate(
    n_methods = rowSums(across(all_of(methods))),
    overlap_category = case_when(
      n_methods == 1 ~ "Detected by 1 method",
      n_methods == 2 ~ "Detected by 2 methods",
      n_methods == 3 ~ "Detected by 3 methods",
      n_methods == 4 ~ "Detected by 4 methods",
      #n_methods == 5 ~ "Detected by 5 methods",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_methods), CHR, POS)

glimpse(upset_master_table)

# Check final counts per method
method_counts_from_master <- upset_master_table %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(methods), ~sum(.x))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "n_outliers"
  )

print(method_counts_from_master)

# Save as .csv

write_csv(
  upset_master_table,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(species_prefix, "_master_outlier_overlap_table.csv"))
)

write_csv(
  upset_master_table %>% filter(n_methods >= 2),
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(species_prefix, "_outliers_shared_by_2_or_more_methods.csv"))
)

write_csv(
  upset_master_table %>% filter(n_methods >= 3),
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(species_prefix, "_outliers_shared_by_3_or_more_methods.csv"))
)

write_csv(
  upset_master_table %>% filter(n_methods >= 4),
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(species_prefix, "_outliers_shared_by_4_or_more_methods.csv"))
)

#write_csv(
  #upset_master_table %>% filter(n_methods == 5),
  #file.path(output_dir, paste0(species_prefix, "_outliers_shared_by_all_5_methods.csv"))
#)

```

# 11. UpSet plot and save it (For AND and BOM)

```{r}
# ============================================================
# UpSet plot
# Intersections shared by 2, 3, 4 or 5 methods
# Highlight 3+/4+/5-method intersections in red
# ============================================================

library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

methods <- c(
  "BayPass_C2",
  "BayPass_BF",
  "BayPass_LocalScores",
  #"BayeScan",
  "PCAdapt"
)

methods_plot <- rev(methods)

upset_master_table_2plus <- upset_master_table %>%
  filter(n_methods %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5)) %>%
  mutate(
    intersection_support = if_else(
      n_methods >= 3,
      "Shared by 3 or 4 methods",
      "Shared by 2 methods"
    ),
    intersection_support = factor(
      intersection_support,
      levels = c(
        "Shared by 2 methods",
        "Shared by 3 or 4 methods"
      )
    )
  )

intersection_counts_2plus <- upset_master_table_2plus %>%
  count(across(all_of(methods)), name = "intersection_size")

max_intersection_size <- max(intersection_counts_2plus$intersection_size)

size <- get_size_mode("exclusive_intersection")

upset_plot <- upset(
  upset_master_table_2plus,
  intersect = methods_plot,
  name = "Method",
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  min_size = 1,
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  width_ratio = 0.10,
  
  matrix = intersection_matrix(
    geom = geom_point(size = 3),
    segment = geom_segment(linewidth = 0.6)
  ),
  
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = (
      intersection_size(
        mapping = aes(
          fill = intersection_support
        ),
        text_mapping = aes(
          label = paste0(
            !!upset_text_percentage(digits = 1),
            "\n(",
            !!size,
            ")"
          ),
          y = !!size + max_intersection_size * 0.08
        ),
        text = list(
          colour = "black",
          size = 3
        )
      ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c(
            "Shared by 2 methods" = "grey40",
            "Shared by 3 or 4 methods" = "red3"
          ),
          name = "Intersection support"
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = c(0, max_intersection_size * 1.45),
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
        ) +
        ylab("Intersection size") +
        theme(
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#E5D3B3", colour = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#E5D3B3", colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank()
        )
    )
  ),
  
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(
      geom = geom_bar(width = 0.7, fill = "grey40")
    ) +
      xlab("Set size")
  )
) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

upset_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(species_prefix, "_UpSet_outlier_overlap_5_methods_ComplexUpset.png")
  ),
  plot = upset_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 400
)

```

# 12. UpSet plot and save it (For LML)

```{r}
# ============================================================
# UpSet plot
# Intersections shared by 1 or 2 methods
# Highlight 2-method intersections in red
# ============================================================

library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

methods <- c(
  "BayPass_C2",
  "BayPass_BF",
  "BayPass_LocalScores",
  #"BayeScan",
  "PCAdapt"
)

methods_plot <- rev(methods)

# Keep only SNPs detected by 1 or 2 methods
# Exclude the "Not detected" row
upset_master_table_1to2 <- upset_master_table %>%
  filter(n_methods %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(
    intersection_support = if_else(
      n_methods == 2,
      "Shared by 2 methods",
      "Shared by 1 method"
    ),
    intersection_support = factor(
      intersection_support,
      levels = c(
        "Shared by 1 method",
        "Shared by 2 methods"
      )
    )
  )

# Calculate intersection sizes
intersection_counts_1to2 <- upset_master_table_1to2 %>%
  count(across(all_of(methods)), name = "intersection_size")

max_intersection_size <- max(intersection_counts_1to2$intersection_size)

size <- get_size_mode("exclusive_intersection")

upset_plot <- upset(
  upset_master_table_1to2,
  intersect = methods_plot,
  name = "Method",
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  min_size = 1,
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  width_ratio = 0.10,

  matrix = intersection_matrix(
    geom = geom_point(size = 3),
    segment = geom_segment(linewidth = 0.6)
  ),

  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = (
      intersection_size(
        mapping = aes(
          fill = intersection_support
        ),
        text_mapping = aes(
          label = paste0(
            !!upset_text_percentage(digits = 1),
            "\n(",
            !!size,
            ")"
          ),
          y = !!size + max_intersection_size * 0.08
        ),
        text = list(
          colour = "black",
          size = 3
        )
      ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c(
            "Shared by 1 method" = "grey40",
            "Shared by 2 methods" = "red3"
          ),
          drop = TRUE,
          name = NULL
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = c(0, max_intersection_size * 1.45),
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
        ) +
        ylab("Intersection size") +
        theme(
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#E5D3B3", colour = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#E5D3B3", colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank()
        )
    )
  ),

  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(
      geom = geom_bar(width = 0.7, fill = "grey40")
    ) +
      xlab("Set size")
  )
) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

upset_plot

  filename = file.path(
```
